notes.title: Graphics update - game release date postponed.
notes.notes: [h1]Good News [/h1][p]I’ve teamed up with [b]Marcin Mielczarek[/b] - who’s now reworking my helicopter – or better yet, totally redesigning it from scratch 😄 The new one’s gonna be sleek, futuristic, and just plain cool. Find out the sketches bellow. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45462959/0a6ad98c32e20b8b667e7651356c2408333bec15.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Marcin has been in game-dev business for a long time, so definitely check out his portfolio at [url="https://www.mielczarekart.com"]https://www.mielczarekart.com[/url]. [/p][h1]Bad News - the release date[/h1][p]Due to major visual changes and new models being worked on, [b]the game’s release has been pushed to October 1st 2025[/b]. Yeah, yeah – I know, I just broke a few hearts out there 😅 But hey, good things are worth waiting an extra month or two, right?[/p][p]Hang in there, pilots – it's gonna be worth it![/p]
